topic: Gaban spotted Zoro's Supreme King Haki in chapter 1152 and called him out for not noticing it himself
title: Zoro Had Supreme King Haki and Never Noticed
description: In chapter 1152, Scopper Gaban pointed out something Zoro had been carrying without realizing it: Supreme King Haki. Gaban's scolding says a lot about how seriously the old pirate takes that power. Here's the scene most fans skip.
comment: Was Gaban right to scold Zoro in front of Luffy, or was he being too harsh on his own crewmate?

lines.text: Zoro had Supreme King Haki, and he never even noticed.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman with three swords, dark aura, anime style

lines.text: In chapter 1152, Scopper Gaban told Luffy someone else in the crew had it.

shot.fallback: old pirate with white ponytail talking to a young captain, Elbaph castle

lines.text: Sanji assumed it was him. It wasn't.

shot.fallback: blond cook and green haired swordsman standing side by side

lines.text: It was Zoro. Luffy had already sensed it, but Zoro had no clue.

shot.fallback: young captain and swordsman side by side, aura glowing

lines.text: Gaban called him out for being oblivious, and Zoro sheepishly apologized.

shot.fallback: embarrassed swordsman scratching his head, anime style

lines.text: The point was blunt. If you serve an Emperor, you control your Haki on purpose.

shot.fallback: old pirate lecturing a swordsman, serious expression

lines.text: I think most fans skip that scene. It matters.

shot.fallback: two warriors talking on a giant tree branch

lines.text: Luffy knew, but Gaban was the one who said it out loud.

shot.fallback: old pirate pointing at a swordsman, dramatic light

lines.text: But that's only the warning. What Gaban did next is what makes the rank debate hard.

shot.fallback: old pirate standing ready for battle, dramatic sky

lines.text: Because Zoro's own power stayed hidden until an old pirate pointed it out.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman with dark aura, looking surprised

self_check.hook: Names Zoro in the first line and the claim is checkable against chapter 1152.
self_check.loop: Last line opens with 'Because' and explains the power that line 1 introduced.
